material_limits: The initial TLS check cannot see ECH inner names, later encrypted requests or traffic outside the proxy.
The default-Strict hold begins only after its policy is installed; it can hold legitimate first-party resources.
Unscopable IP, localhost, single-label, public-suffix and certain wildcard registry-base addresses remain held under default Strict.
Inline scripts and cached/service-worker-generated responses are outside the preparation hold.
Grant and transient-context expiry use scheduled reconciliation, not a hard browser-enforced timer.
Cosmetic source-rule counts do not establish ad-removal efficacy; bounded discovery may leave unmatched content.
ChromeSetting readback does not prove routing, public-IP masking or complete third-party cookie suppression.
Native receipt status does not prove browser-profile identity, routing or device-wide coverage.
